pages.text: The $(l)Teddy Qilin$() is a mythical variant of the Teddy Bear. She retains her predecessor's versatility but moves with $(b)superior speed$() on the battlefield.

pages.title: Equipment & Stats
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 15$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 10$(li)$(6)Base Damage:$() 4$(br2)She can wield $(b)Swords, Bows, or Shields$(). Her high agility allows her to close gaps faster than any other Teddy variant.
Crafted with the spirit of a swift mythical warrior.
